tools.name: execute_menu_item
tools.description: Executes a Unity menu item by path

menuPath.description: The path to the menu item to execute (e.g. "GameObject/Create Empty")

tools.name: select_gameobject
tools.description: Sets the selected GameObject in the Unity editor by path, name or instance ID

objectPath.description: The path or name of the GameObject to select (e.g. "Main Camera")

objectName.description: The name of the GameObject to select

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the GameObject to select

tools.name: add_package
tools.description: Adds packages into the Unity Package Manager

source.description: The source to use (registry, github, or disk) to add the package

packageName.description: The package name to add from Unity registry (e.g. com.unity.textmeshpro)

version.description: The version to use for registry packages (optional)

branch.description: The branch to use for GitHub packages (optional)

path.description: The path to use (folder path for disk method or subfolder for GitHub)

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Runs Unity's Test Runner tests

testMode.description: The test mode to run (EditMode or PlayMode) - defaults to EditMode (optional)

testFilter.description: The specific test filter to run (e.g. specific test name or class name, must include namespace) (optional)

returnOnlyFailures.description: Whether to show only failed tests in the results (optional)

returnWithLogs.description: Whether to return the test logs in the results (optional)

tools.name: send_console_log
tools.description: Sends console log messages to the Unity console

message.description: The message to display in the Unity console

type.description: The type of message (info, warning, error) - defaults to info (optional)

tools.name: get_console_logs
tools.description: Retrieves logs from the Unity console with pagination support to avoid token limits

logType.description: The type of logs to retrieve (info, warning, error) - defaults to all logs if not specified

offset.description: Starting index for pagination (0-based, defaults to 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return (defaults to 50, max 500 to avoid token limits)

includeStackTrace.description: Whether to include stack trace in logs. ⚠️ ALWAYS SET TO FALSE to save 80-90% tokens, unless you specifically need stack traces for debugging. Default: true (except info logs in resource)

tools.name: update_component
tools.description: Updates component fields on a GameObject or adds it to the GameObject if it does not contain the component

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the GameObject to update

objectPath.description: The path of the GameObject in the hierarchy to update (alternative to instanceId)

componentName.description: The name of the component to update or add

componentData.description: An object containing the fields to update on the component (optional)

tools.name: add_asset_to_scene
tools.description: Adds an asset from the AssetDatabase to the Unity scene

assetPath.description: The path of the asset in the AssetDatabase

position.description: Position in the scene (defaults to Vector3.zero)

parentPath.description: The path of the parent GameObject in the hierarchy

parentId.description: The instance ID of the parent GameObject

tools.name: update_gameobject
tools.description: Updates properties of a GameObject in the Unity scene by its instance ID or path. If the GameObject does not exist at the specified path, it will be created.

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the GameObject to update

objectPath.description: The path of the GameObject in the hierarchy to update (alternative to instanceId)

activeSelf.description: Set the active state of the GameObject (GameObject.SetActive(value))

isStatic.description: Set the static state of the GameObject (GameObject.isStatic = value)

gameObjectData.description: An object containing the fields to update on the GameObject. If the GameObject does not exist at objectPath, it will be created.

tools.name: create_prefab
tools.description: Creates a prefab with optional MonoBehaviour script and serialized field values

componentName.description: The name of the MonoBehaviour Component to add to the prefab (optional)

prefabName.description: The name of the prefab to create

fieldValues.description: Optional JSON object of serialized field values to apply to the prefab

tools.name: create_scene
tools.description: Creates a new scene and saves it to the specified path

sceneName.description: The name of the scene to create (without extension)

folderPath.description: The folder path under 'Assets' to save into (default: Assets)

addToBuildSettings.description: Whether to add the scene to Build Settings

makeActive.description: Whether to open/make the new scene active after creating it

tools.name: delete_scene
tools.description: Deletes a scene by path or name and removes it from Build Settings

scenePath.description: Full asset path to the scene (e.g., 'Assets/Scenes/MyScene.unity')

sceneName.description: Scene name without extension (used if scenePath not provided)

folderPath.description: Optional folder scope to resolve sceneName under 'Assets'

tools.name: load_scene
tools.description: Loads a scene by path or name. Supports additive loading (default: false)

scenePath.description: Full asset path to the scene (e.g., 'Assets/Scenes/MyScene.unity')

sceneName.description: Scene name without extension (used if scenePath not provided)

folderPath.description: Optional folder scope to resolve sceneName under 'Assets'

additive.description: Load additively if true; default false

tools.name: save_scene
tools.description: Saves the current active scene. Optionally saves to a new path (Save As)

scenePath.description: The path to save the scene to (e.g., 'Assets/Scenes/MyScene.unity'). Required if saveAs is true

saveAs.description: If true, saves to a new path specified by scenePath. Default: false

tools.name: get_scene_info
tools.description: Gets information about the active scene including name, path, dirty state, root object count, and loaded state. Also returns info about all currently loaded scenes.

tools.name: unload_scene
tools.description: Unloads a scene by path or name (does not delete the scene asset, just closes it from the hierarchy)

scenePath.description: Full asset path to the scene (e.g., 'Assets/Scenes/MyScene.unity')

sceneName.description: Scene name without extension (used if scenePath not provided)

saveIfDirty.description: If true, saves the scene before unloading if it has unsaved changes. Default: true

removeScene.description: If true, removes the scene from the hierarchy. If false, keeps it but unloaded. Default: true

tools.name: recompile_scripts
tools.description: Recompiles all scripts in the Unity project.

logsLimit.description: Maximum number of compilation logs to return

tools.name: get_gameobject
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific GameObject by instance ID, name, or hierarchical path (e.g., 'Parent/Child/MyObject'). Returns component info plus a scoped child hierarchy. Use 'maxDepth', 'includeComponents', and 'includeComponentProperties' to control response size and avoid token/response limits. If a node carries '_truncated: true' with reason 'depth_limit' or 'size_limit_exceeded', re-query that node directly with narrower parameters.

idOrName.description: The instance ID (integer), name, or hierarchical path of the GameObject to retrieve. Use hierarchical paths like 'Canvas/Panel/Button' for nested objects.

maxDepth.description: Maximum child hierarchy depth to traverse. 0 = no children, 1 = direct children, 2 = grandchildren. Default: 2. Increase only when you actually need a deeper tree — large scenes can exceed the MCP 15MB response cap.

includeComponents.description: Include the component list on each node. Set false to get a hierarchy-only outline. Default: true.

includeComponentProperties.description: Include serialized property values for each component. Set false to keep component type names only (saves substantial tokens). Default: true.

tools.name: move_gameobject
tools.description: Moves a GameObject to a new position. Supports world/local space and absolute/relative positioning.

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the GameObject to move

objectPath.description: The path of the GameObject in the hierarchy (alternative to instanceId)

relative.description: If true, adds to current position instead of setting absolute position

tools.name: rotate_gameobject
tools.description: Rotates a GameObject using Euler angles. Supports world/local space and absolute/relative rotation.

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the GameObject to rotate

objectPath.description: The path of the GameObject in the hierarchy (alternative to instanceId)

relative.description: If true, adds to current rotation instead of setting absolute rotation

tools.name: scale_gameobject
tools.description: Scales a GameObject. Supports absolute and relative (multiplicative) scaling.

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the GameObject to scale

objectPath.description: The path of the GameObject in the hierarchy (alternative to instanceId)

relative.description: If true, multiplies current scale instead of setting absolute scale

tools.name: set_transform
tools.description: Sets a GameObject's transform (position, rotation, scale) in one operation. All transform properties are optional.

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the GameObject

objectPath.description: The path of the GameObject in the hierarchy (alternative to instanceId)

space.description: Coordinate space for position and rotation: "world" or "local"

tools.name: duplicate_gameobject
tools.description: Duplicates a GameObject in the Unity scene. Can create multiple copies and optionally rename or reparent them.

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the GameObject to duplicate

objectPath.description: The path of the GameObject in the hierarchy to duplicate (alternative to instanceId)

newName.description: New name for the duplicated GameObject(s). If count > 1, numbers will be appended.

newParent.description: Path to the new parent GameObject. If not specified, uses the same parent as the original.

newParentId.description: Instance ID of the new parent GameObject (alternative to newParent path).

count.description: Number of copies to create. Default: 1, Max: 100

tools.name: delete_gameobject
tools.description: Deletes a GameObject from the Unity scene. By default, also deletes all children.

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the GameObject to delete

objectPath.description: The path of the GameObject in the hierarchy to delete (alternative to instanceId)

includeChildren.description: If true (default), deletes all children. If false, children are moved to the deleted object's parent.

tools.name: reparent_gameobject
tools.description: Changes the parent of a GameObject. Can move to a new parent or to the root level (null parent).

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the GameObject to reparent

objectPath.description: The path of the GameObject in the hierarchy to reparent (alternative to instanceId)

newParent.description: Path to the new parent GameObject. Use null to move to root level.

newParentId.description: Instance ID of the new parent GameObject. Use null to move to root level.

worldPositionStays.description: If true (default), the world position is preserved. If false, local position is reset to zero.

tools.name: create_material
tools.description: Creates a new material with the specified shader and saves it to the project. Use the "color" parameter for easy color setting.

shader.description: The shader name. Auto-detects render pipeline if not specified (URP: "Universal Render Pipeline/Lit", Built-in: "Standard")

savePath.description: The asset path to save the material (e.g., "Assets/Materials/MyMaterial.mat")

color.description: The base color of the material. Auto-detects correct property name (_BaseColor for URP, _Color for Standard)

properties.description: Optional initial property values as key-value pairs (advanced usage)

tools.name: assign_material
tools.description: Assigns a material to a GameObject's Renderer component at a specific material slot

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the GameObject

objectPath.description: The path of the GameObject in the hierarchy (alternative to instanceId)

materialPath.description: The asset path to the material (e.g., "Assets/Materials/MyMaterial.mat")

tools.name: modify_material
tools.description: Modifies properties of an existing material. Supports colors (e.g., _Color), floats (e.g., _Metallic), and textures (e.g., _MainTex path)

materialPath.description: The asset path to the material (e.g., "Assets/Materials/MyMaterial.mat")

properties.description: Property name to value mapping. Colors: {r,g,b,a}, Vectors: {x,y,z,w}, Floats: number, Textures: asset path string

tools.name: get_material_info
tools.description: Gets detailed information about a material including its shader and all properties with current values

materialPath.description: The asset path to the material (e.g., "Assets/Materials/MyMaterial.mat")

tools.name: batch_execute
tools.description:
Executes multiple tool operations in a single batch request.
Reduces network round-trips and enables atomic operations with rollback support.
Performance improvement: 10-100x for repetitive operations.

tool.description: The name of the tool to execute

params.description: Parameters to pass to the tool

id.description: Optional identifier for this operation (for tracking in results)

operations.description: Array of operations to execute sequentially

stopOnError.description: If true, stops execution on the first error. Default: true

atomic.description: If true, rolls back all operations if any fails (uses Unity Undo system). Default: false
